description: 日本海溝_津波_(6)堤防データ [dams, reservoirs and flood defences and tsunami] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 内閣府　中央防災会議　日本海溝・千島海溝周辺海溝型地震に関する専門調査会. 堤防の配置と高さを与えるデータ 問い合わせの際には、問い合わせフォームの「ご意見、ご感想」記入欄の冒頭に【震度分布・浸水域等に係るデータに関する問い合わせ】とご記入ください。 データのダウンロードは、ユーザ登録の後、 ログイン状態で行ってください。 座標系は、日本測地系（「旧測地系」）です。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 内閣府　中央防災会議　日本海溝・千島海溝周辺海溝型地震に関する専門調査会. Its tags are 津波. It offers 6 resource(s) in doc, pdf, zip. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
